long_biography.plain_text:
A wave of appointments in 2011 brought Poullain into executive control of several established French property vehicles. Some owned and let land or buildings; others handled transactions or related finance. Further mandates followed in Levallois-Perret, Les Mureaux, Montolieu and Hyères, extending a private structure centred on the same Paris headquarters.

More than a decade later, he took the presidency of a newly incorporated company with a broad remit covering purchases, building work, leasing and disposals. He has commonly served as both manager and unlimited-liability partner, indicating direct responsibility for the entities rather than a detached board role. Their small, private-company form leaves the scale and ownership of the wider portfolio undisclosed.

uncertainties: Identity is resolved at 100. The official Black Swan website names Edouard Poullain as current owner and gives the exact 40.2-metre dimension. Its SIRET and Paris address match commercial records that join the October 1966 French manager of BLACK SWAN 1899 to Y.P. Immobilier, EPMB and other property companies. The company formed in October 2017, the same month as the authoritative vessel relationship.

The supported full legal name is Edouard Romuald Yvon Poullain. Current commercial notices and multiple BODACC entries use Romuald Yvon. One older BODACC extraction renders the first middle name Roumauld, but later and repeated official records support Romuald, which is proposed at 100.

French prose often styles the given name Édouard, but Poullain's official company notices, registry-derived profile, yacht website and regatta entries consistently use Edouard without an accent. The dossier preserves that evidenced form and does not impose a stylistic accent correction.

October 1966 is reported in multiple French registry-derived executive profiles and independently fits the input age of 53 on 7 May 2020. The public registry suppresses the exact day, so birth_day remains unproposed.

The yacht-company legal notice and official company records provide an exact address and direct contact details, but these are used only as collision anchors and are excluded from biographies and proposals. No private residential address is reproduced.

Real Estate is both the wealth-creation and primary industry because the sustained business record is dominated by property acquisition, holding, rental, management and trading companies. The creation classification is lower-confidence than the primary classification because public records do not disclose personal asset values or the original capital source.

The amended reasonable-inference audit resolves Wealth Origin to Marriage / family transfer at medium confidence. A Musée des Arts Décoratifs report explicitly identifies Yvon Poullain as Edouard's father; commercial records show Edouard succeeding the deceased Yvon as manager and partner of pre-existing property companies and retaining current manager-partner interests across the same network. This positive convergence supplies the family-platform, succession and current-economic-interest premises. Because the precise legal transfer instrument and ownership percentages are not public, the classification records inferred family succession rather than inheritance. Inherited variants lack an explicit inheritance; broad Self-made would disregard the transferred family platform; Mixed lacks a separately built origin mechanism shown to be independently material.

Operator is supported by recurring gérant, associé-gérant and president roles across the current property network. Founder is not used because several core companies pre-date his management and the evidence does not show that he created the original platform.

Competitive sailing is the only approved active tag proposed. Multi-year official results and current owner-restorer evidence satisfy the catalogue's sustained ownership and competitive-identity rule. Property developer and real-estate specialist tags are not used because the records establish property management and holding, not a sufficiently specific development or institutional-investment mandate.

The Black Swan 1899 site is proposed as Company Website because its legal notice identifies Poullain as publication manager and matches the exact registered company. It is not treated as a personal website or as evidence that yacht chartering created his principal wealth.

No identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, personal website or other controlled social profile was found. Common-name results and an unrelated historical author named Édouard Poullain were excluded.
Forbes searches found no dedicated profile for this owner. No unrelated Poullain result or company mention is substituted as a personal profile.
